2609.01245.title: Explore More, Drift Less: Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning Can Suffice for Long-Horizon Interactive Agents
2609.01245.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning is a natural way to post-train LLM agents for long-horizon interactive tasks judged only by end-of-task verification, yet a shared belief holds that outcome-only RL soon hits a ceiling on small open models. Recent work therefore compensates around the training with denser rewards, SFT priors, skill libraries, curated memory, or multi-agent orchestration. We argue the ceiling is an artifact of two failures of common practice. Signal starvation: group-relative RL with sparse outcome-only rewards yields a gradient only when a task's rollout group mixes successes and failures, so under-scaled exploration silences exactly the hardest, most instructive tasks. Policy drift: squeezing many updates out of a small task pool degrades the policy itself, as an unanchored objective lets the sampling distribution collapse exactly when saturation has already made informative groups rare. We present CANOPY (Coverage-ANchored On-PolicY RL), a minimalist protocol attacking both directly: scale same-task exploration until the natural signal reappears, keep every update on-policy, KL-anchored, and confined to the agent's own action tokens, then cash in an enlarged interaction budget at test time. On AppWorld, a long-horizon interactive coding benchmark, a Qwen3-14B policy trained with CANOPY through environment interaction alone--without task-specific supervision, auxiliary credit signals, or elaborate agent scaffolding--topped the public leaderboard (Feb. 2026; Test-Normal TGC 86.9, Test-Challenge 67.6), and the same design principles lift Qwen3.5-9B on SWE-bench Verified by 16.6 points. Agentic RL alone thus internalizes long-horizon capability directly into a small open model; we plan to release the complete training stack at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/SignalCoverageRL.
2609.01245.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習是一種自然的方法，用於對大型語言模型（LLM）代理進行後訓練，以應對僅通過任務結束驗證評估的長期互動任務，但普遍的信念認為，僅依賴結果的強化學習在小型開放模型上很快會達到瓶頸。因此，最近的研究通過更密集的獎勵、SFT先驗、技能庫、策劃的記憶或多代理協調來彌補訓練的不足。我們認為這一瓶頸是常見做法的兩個失敗的產物。信號匱乏：相對於群體的強化學習在稀疏的僅結果獎勵下，只有當任務的展開組合併了成功和失敗時才會產生梯度，因此縮小的探索恰恰會使最困難、最具啟發性的任務沉默。政策漂移：從小任務池中擠出許多更新會使政策本身退化，因為一個未固定的目標會讓採樣分佈在飽和已經使得有信息的群體變得稀少時崩潰。我們提出了CANOPY（Coverage-ANchored On-PolicY RL），這是一種極簡的協議，直接攻擊這兩個問題：擴大同任務的探索，直到自然信號重新出現，保持每次更新都在政策上，KL固定，並限制於代理自己的行動標記，然後在測試時利用擴大的互動預算。在AppWorld這個長期互動編碼基準上，通過環境互動單獨訓練的Qwen3-14B政策--沒有任務特定的監督、輔助信用信號或複雜的代理支架--在公共排行榜上名列前茅（2026年2月；測試正常TGC 86.9，測試挑戰67.6），同樣的設計原則使Qwen3.5-9B在SWE-bench上提高了16.6分。因此，僅依賴代理的強化學習直接將長期能力內化到小型開放模型中；我們計劃在https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/SignalCoverageRL上發布完整的訓練堆棧。
